objective: Build an Electron + React desktop app called 'Viral Desktop' (MVP scope, 1 hour deadline). User types objectives, Viral asks clarifying questions iteratively in chat, user answers, Viral executes and shows progress live. Left sidebar: task queue with realtime updates. Right sidebar (collapsible): diagnostic panel (task progress %, token usage, system health, recent logs, errors). System tray: click toggles window, right-click menu. Auto-start on Windows. Dark theme, cyan/purple accents. 900x600 resizable. HTTP daemon server + WebSocket. Tailwind CSS. Deliverable: working app (npm run desktop:dev works). Include tests for chat, task queue, diagnostics.

AGENTS.md Scope Discipline separately excludes desktop UI unless the active milestone requires it.

Nothing has changed since the prior block that would resolve it: STATE.json.currentMilestone is still M05_VOICE_INTERFACE; no milestones/M06_*.md specification exists on this branch to authoritatively define required design, boundaries, and verification for M06; D025's 'M06 -- Viral Desktop' still conflicts with ROADMAP.md's own M06 entry ('Desktop Control -- safe Windows/OS automation'); D025 itself approved M06 explicitly 'to follow M05 voice', and no src/voice implementation exists on this branch. A repeated resubmission of the same objective text is not owner approval to proceed (see D024's identical finding for the earlier duplicate M05 objectives).
No Electron/React/desktop implementation code was written.

This is at least the fifth submission of this exact objective text across branches (feat/m05-voice: OBJ-20260912062649417, OBJ-20260912062748956, OBJ-20260912062813043; this branch: OBJ-20260912064652626, OBJ-20260912070218517), all blocked for the same reason.
